svg.aria-label: Same angle, smaller triangle: the Twist shrinks both the sound ruler and the distance to the oldest light by about 2.9 percent, so the notes stay in place but the universe must expand faster.
svg.metadata:  Cosmic Bell triangle. Theory by Danny Lee Eldridge, 2026. AEGIS.
svg.text: standard model: ruler 144.9 Mpc, distance 13,904 Mpc
the Twist: ruler 140.7 Mpc, distance 13,511 Mpc
Ruler -2.9%, distance -2.8%: the angle, and so every note, stays put.
A shorter distance to the same light means a faster expansion: H₀ 67.98 → 70.6 km/s per Mpc.
Angle drawn 30 times larger than the real 0.6° so it can be seen; lengths in true proportion. Mpc = megaparsec, about 3.26 million light-years.
